# Device State Console v3.0.179

## Android One UI motion, control sizing, and navigation polish

- Recalibrate `OneUiMotion` to Samsung's official One UI Basic path interpolator `(0.22, 0.25, 0.00, 1.00)` and SESL `SineInOut90 / 80 / 70 / 33` easing curves with official `100–500ms` interactive durations (`Press 130ms`, `Toggle 280ms`, `TabSwitch 260ms`, `Content 320ms`, `Screen 420ms`).
- Separate top-level bottom navigation tab transitions (`oneUiTabTransition` crossfade) from sub-screen transitions (`oneUiScreenTransition`), and add smooth state color transitions, checkbox checkmark path animations, dialog enter motion, and `LazyColumn` `animateItem` placement transitions.
- Upgrade `OneUiBottomBar` to a One UI 7/8 floating pill navigation bar with a single gliding spring indicator (removing the double-halo selected state), fix `OneUiTopBar` two-phase non-overlapping title collapse to eliminate top-left ghost text, and resolve the top-bar Edit vs. bottom-bar Settings icon collision.
- Decouple read-only badges (`28dp`) from interactive filter/action chips (`38dp` visual height with `13.5sp Chip` typography and `48dp` touch targets), rebalance `OneUiSegmentedRow` (`46dp` / compact `38dp`), adopt concentric `26dp / 22dp / 16dp` corners, and add horizontal fading edges to scrollable chip strips.

## Android chart alignment, overview layout, and cross-screen fixes

- Fix `OneUiTrendChart` canvas Z-order, safe plot insets (`plotTop 18dp` / `plotBottom 12dp` / `plotLeft/Right 8dp`), and anti-collision threshold labels so dashed `90%`/`98%` lines (muted `0.55f` until approaching) and the crosshair never strike through `100%` axis ticks or clip edge cursor markers.
- Sync scrubbed multi-device comparison cursor readouts directly into the bottom clickable peer chips, removing the crowded colliding inline legend above the chart and verbose instructional copy.
- Simplify the overview header from three sticky pill rows into a single sticky group strip plus a scrollable compact time-window/action row, remove the redundant top alert pill (already badged on the bottom Attention tab), add an offline-only filter switch in `ViewAndSortSheet`, and equalize 2×2 pooled metric cell heights with full-width CPU peak captions and balanced dual-line throughput.
- Scroll-enable secondary strips on `DeviceDetailScreen`, add checkmarks/radio semantics to network modes in `SettingsScreen`, and demote the secondary button on `OnboardingScreen` to `Tonal`.

## Validation

- Source and workspace package manifests are synchronized at `3.0.179` (`pnpm verify:version` and `pnpm check:release-notes-layout`).
- Android `:app:assembleDebug`, `:app:testDebugUnitTest` (including `OneUiDesignContractTest`, `OneUiSourceContractTest`, and dark three-peer `ScreenRenderTest`), `:app:lintDebug`, full workspace verification, and the tagged release/package workflows run in GitHub Actions.

This is a test-channel prerelease for v3.0.179.
